correctness.rationale: The trapped stationary active position is a bounded exponential convolution, so the generator identities apply to the required angular monomials. The Fourier index q-p exactly compensates the positional monomial under rotations; the symmetric flip operator acts as 0 on the sign-even term and -2ell on the sign-odd one. The recursion has strictly positive determinant at every positive degree, and independent symbolic reconstruction through degree four reproduced the frozen rational identity and critical factorization (replay: independent_algebra.py in /workspace/branches/e35f2848-31a2-448f-9a63-69c8ba96e2f8/). As a separate algebraic cross-check on the boundary, set b_j=j+g+2ell, D_j=(j+g)b_j+W for j=1,3, L=H/(D_1^2 D_3). Integration of the six angular orderings with two positive and two negative charges gives S_22=2/(D_3 D_1) times [b_3 b_1 + {b_3 b_1(2+4g+2ell)-W(2b_3+2b_1+2+4g)}/(4L)]. Indeed the chronological Fourier resolvents use rates 3,2,1 and intermediate modes (1,2,1), (1,0,1), (1,0,-1) and their negatives. After subtracting 2(b_1/D_1)^2 the coefficient of W^2 over H is 3b_1-b_3-(1+2g)=4ell-1. Rotation gives projected second and fourth radial factors 1/2 and 3/8. The independent thermal Gaussian term contributes zero fourth cumulant. Positivity of H and C then makes the concave/linear/convex quadratic cases exhaustive, including the subcritical double root, critical B=0 and W=0. The quarter boundary governs the leading high-speed sign for ell not equal to 1/4; the finite-speed count also depends on g, as the formal three cases state. A zero does not imply Gaussianity.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies a sharp, rotational-diffusion-independent high-speed boundary in a model with an independently changing torque sign, and classifies finite-speed reentrant positive kurtosis, tangency, and absence of a positive region. This is a complete sign diagram from a nontrivial fourth-order moment calculation; it is not a recomputation of known second-order observables. Invariance of the sign under independent translational diffusion gives an additional robust interpretation, without implying experimental detectability or classifying the complete density.
